title: Build system and product TUI navigation
summary: Implement `/wiki system <diagram type>` and `/wiki product` terminal navigation from canonical KB diagrams and product docs.

goal.outcome: Users can browse source-backed system diagrams and product knowledge in the terminal through `/wiki system <diagram type>` and `/wiki product`.
acceptance: `/wiki system <diagram type>` lists available canonical diagram types and renders the selected diagram from `.codewiki/kb/system/diagrams/**` or a generated lens derived from those sources.
The system diagram TUI lets users move between components or flows, highlights the selected item in ASCII/Unicode, and opens or renders the linked component/flow Markdown source on Enter.
System diagram rendering uses focused lanes, neighborhoods, ordered steps, state transitions, trees, or entity cards instead of full raw graph output.
`/wiki product` offers overview or users as the top-level choice; overview opens or renders `.codewiki/kb/product/overview.md`.
The product users view lists product users, lets users toggle each user's stories, and opens or renders the corresponding product KB Markdown source on Enter.
Views show source refs and omitted-count/focus metadata when content is summarized.
TUI output does not create hidden UI-only truth and does not depend on deprecated browser UI code.
non_goals: Do not implement a browser dashboard.
Do not render the full generated graph by default.
Do not implement all future diagram layouts beyond the existing canonical diagram families needed for first useful navigation.
Do not change canonical diagram YAML schema unless a focused validation need requires it.
